name: Xylopropamine
summary: Xylopropamine, also known as 3,4-dimethylamphetamine (DMeA) and sold under the brand names Perhedrin and Esanin, is a stimulant and sympathomimetic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families which was developed and marketed as an appetite suppressant in the 1950s. It was briefly sold as the sulfate salt, but it was not widely marketed.
